posts.text: Q1FY27 numbers are out, and there’s a lot to like here. Sharing my read, would love to hear where others land on this. Revenue came in at ₹37.87cr, up 32.4% YoY but basically flat versus Q4FY26’s ₹37.77cr. The real story is margins, gross margin jumped to 72.4% from 66.2% a year ago, and EBITDA margin went to 47.6% from 39.5%. PAT grew 67.2% YoY to ₹13.28cr, EPS came in at ₹4.24 versus ₹2.53 last year. The margin move happened against the input-cost tape, not because of it. Methacrylic acid prices in India were actually up ~5.5% QoQ in that period, and MMA firmed further too. So this doesn’t l…
